proposed_widenings.name: species_lineage_progression_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is a build-time choice over lineage packages with level-gated grants at character levels 1, 3, and 5. The current species-trait families only support a flat passive grant list or a single activated ability.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellcastingAbilityChoice
proposed_widenings.justification: The lineage-granted spells use a build-time choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as their spellcasting ability, and the current spell-access grant shape has no way to carry that binding.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.mutable_cantrip_list
proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf pressure requires a granted cantrip that can be replaced on each Long Rest from a named spell list, which the current spell-access modes do not model.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

notes: I did not author content/species_elf_elven_lineage.dhall because any current-shape encoding would either collapse the lineage choice, omit the level-3/5 progression, or lie about the High Elf cantrip replacement and chosen spellcasting ability.
